title: Process observation in an integrated Emergency Department
summary:
Since October 2023, the University Medical Center Freiburg has operated an Integrated Emergency Center (INZ). A key element is the initial assessment at the so-called “common desk.” Here, walk-in patients receive an assessment of urgency and are assigned either to the out-of-hours practice or to the emergency department, depending on their presenting complaints.
This study aims to evaluate whether the initial assessment works reliably. Specifically, it will examine:
- whether the proposed urgency level and treatment sector are appropriate,
- whether severe events (e.g., heart attack, stroke, multiple trauma, or death) occur less frequently among correctly assigned patients,
- how often hospital admission is required and how long patients stay,
- and whether the initial assessment is completed within the intended ten minutes.
The analysis is based exclusively on anonymized routine data. No conclusions can be drawn about individual persons. Since the initial assessment described above is performed anonymously using a waiting number, only anonymized routine data need to be added for this study (age, diagnosis, case management, death), which do not allow any identification of individuals.
conditions: CEDIS chief complaints, ICD-10 discharge diagnoses of all emergency patients

interventions.name: Observation Group 1: Ambulatory patients who visit an emergency department (ED) are referred to as self-presenting patients (with referral to the ambulatory part of the integrated emergency center or the ED itself) and are compared to patients in Arm 2 (those brought in by emergency services) based
Observation Group 2: Emergency patients who are brought in by emergency services. There is no intervention, only an analysis of routine data.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
All ambulatory patients that presented to the INZ since 18.10.23, control group all patients that were admitted by ambulance /EMS. In addition, retrospective comparison with the emergency population from July 1, 2012 to October 17, 2023
Exclusion criteria:
none
